versions.subject: new rules: Sigma rules based on Elastic rules (#3632)
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '/Script Editor'
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith:
        - '/curl'
        - '/bash'
        - '/sh'
        - '/zsh'
        - '/osascript'
        - '/mktemp'
        - '/chmod'
        - '/php'
        - '/nohup'
        - '/openssl'
        - '/plutil'
        - '/PlistBuddy'
        - '/xattr'
        - '/sqlite'
        - '/funzip'
        - '/popen'
    - Image|contains:
        - 'python'
        - 'perl'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: ParentImage="*/Script Editor" Image IN ("*/curl", "*/bash", "*/sh", "*/zsh", "*/osascript", "*/mktemp", "*/chmod", "*/php", "*/nohup", "*/openssl", "*/plutil", "*/PlistBuddy", "*/xattr", "*/sqlite", "*/funzip", "*/popen") OR Image IN ("*python*", "*perl*")
